description: Heading back to Middle Tennessee this weekend! Last time, I was able to visit the Nashville Farmer's Market along with the Tennessee State Museum. This weekend, I'll be making stops in between Knoxville and Nashville along the way. This Saturday, I will be visiting Gallatin's Farmer's Market in the morning, visiting Red Boiling Springs in the afternoon, and attending a candidate forum in Antioch that evening.
